job.job_description:
Core AI Engineer (Fresher)




Core AI Engineer (Fresher)

Employment Type: 45-Day Unpaid Internship.
Experience: Freshers (2025 & 2026 Pass-outs Preferred)

Location: Hyderabad (Local Candidates Preferred)

Qualification: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE).




Job Summary:




We are hiring passionate fresh graduates with a strong interest in Generative AI and AI application development. The role involves building AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, and modern AI frameworks while developing scalable APIs and enterprise AI solutions.




Required Skills:



Python Programming
Generative AI & LLMs
Prompt Engineering
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
AI Agents
LangChain / LangGraph
Vector Databases & Embeddings
FastAPI & API Integration
AI Evaluation (Hallucination Reduction & Response Quality)
Strong Logical Thinking & Problem-Solving Skills



Responsibilities:



Build AI-powered applications using LLMs and RAG.
Develop AI Agents and workflow automation.
Implement semantic search using embeddings and vector databases.
Design and integrate AI APIs using FastAPI.
Evaluate and optimize AI model responses.
Collaborate on real-time AI projects and enterprise solutions.



Eligibility:



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
Good understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI application development.
Academic, personal, or certification-based AI projects are preferred.



Employment & Performance Evaluation:




This is a full-time position from the date of joining.

During the first 45 days, candidates will work on assigned real-time AI projects as part of a performance evaluation. Based on their technical performance, learning ability, problem-solving skills, and overall contribution, the company will finalize the Full-Time CTC.

Note: This is not an internship. It is a full-time employment opportunity with a 45-day performance evaluation period.




Mail : mounika.g@sapphirus.in
